I regret leaving the military. I regret getting out and getting married. I miss being bent over an IED in some godforsaken shit-hole holding a flashlight between my teeth while cutting blasting cap wires. I miss the fear of knowing that if I missed a secondary device or firing system, at best, there'd be nothing left of me but some of my gear and a few sticky chunks of meat. I miss the thrill of disarming one and pulling it out of the ground like some sort of trophy. I miss being shot at, I miss shooting back. I don't miss the screams of injured, and the quiet ones who going into shock were somehow even worse than the screamers. I do miss knowing what the dollar value on my head, personally, was. I miss the cold simplicity of trying not to get killed, or worse. I miss not having a reason to live and feeling more alive than I ever did before or since because of it. It put the mundane problems of life into stark relief. For a while, there was no point getting angry at petty BS problems back in civilization after coming home from all that.

Now, I find myself bored out of my fucking mind, sitting around doing nothing of value. I'm physically broken, I've gotten fat, lazier, and I'm not fucking happy with my life. The calm has faded since I got out, and I'm back to my old, impatient, easily angered self. I fear I've wasted my life, and now the only thing left is the inexorable decline into elderly destitution and misery.

When I was young, I was the good kid. Didn't smoke, didn't do drugs, didn't drink, didn't have sex (in short, I didn't have fun). I still haven't done drugs, and there are days I desperately want to go out and just go nuts. Weed, 'shrooms, ketamine... just fucking lose my goddamned mind for a couple of weeks in some sort of Hunter S. Thompson-esque bender. Unfortunately, there's that small, but ever-present chance that I'll get piss tested at work, and while I hate my job, I can't risk getting fired just for enjoying myself for a change.

Even sex has gotten boring. Instead of the twisted, kinky, debauched fun we used to have, now, I'd rather just play with myself than fuck. Sex isn't fun any more, it's too much like an obligation, of late. I feel trapped, unable to escape from or fight back against my own life, and it's making me restless, angry, and emotional.
